import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p=params
    A=(1+t)**p[6]*(p[3]+p[4]*np.sqrt(P)+p[5]*P)
    B=t**p[9]*(p[7]*P+p[8]*P**2)
    return p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2 + A + B
